scope: Author-labelled exploratory pilot, not independent gold or held-out confirmation. Explicit first-person current external operation; explicit asymmetric evidence requests and separate framing. AMBIGUOUS is not a negative label. NO_TARGET is a semantic label; detector ABSTAIN also includes missed positives.
